title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go and bump versions
author: Ava Martinez
description:
This PR standardizes authentication and retry behavior across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, aligns streaming APIs for parity, improves ergonomics, and prepares package version bumps for release. Motivation: multiple downstream teams reported subtle differences in retry semantics (exponential backoff, idempotency handling) and streaming client ergonomics which caused portability issues when switching language SDKs. This change is intended to be non-breaking for well-behaved callers but does include a small ergonomics tweak to streaming client lifecycle (documented in release notes). Changes include: - Unified auth token refresh strategy with transparent background refresh for long-lived clients - Centralized retry logic (max attempts, exponential backoff with jitter, retry-on-idempotent-only by default) - Streaming API surface alignment: consistent event types, reconnect semantics, and an explicit Close/Stop method across SDKs - Improved TypeScript types and Python typing hints for streaming callbacks to reduce footguns - Parity fixes in Go client for header propagation and context cancellation - Bumps: python 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0, typescript 1.9.0 -> 1.10.0, go v0.18.1 -> v0.19.0

Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-1288) - [x] Tests added for retry/backoff edge cases - [x] Streaming integration tests across runtimes - [x] Updated CHANGELOGs and migration notes - [x] CI green

Related: Linear ENG-1288, ENG-1152. Support ticket SUP-451 references intermittent streaming disconnects that motivated this work.

review_comments: Rohan Patel (2026-02-26): Left a few nits on retry default values. Can we make max_attempts configurable at client construction?
Ava Martinez (2026-02-26): Reply: max_attempts is configurable via RetryConfig in all three SDKs; default set to 5. Added example in docs and tests to demonstrate overriding.
Maya Chen (2026-02-27): +1 on ergonomics; one question around streaming reconnect backoff — suggest adding jitter to avoid thundering herd.
Ava Martinez (2026-02-27): Added jitter and updated tests (see internal/common/retries/policy.go).
Liam O'Connor (2026-02-28): Approved after small doc updates. Verified TS and Python release artifacts locally.
release_notes:
- SDKs: Unified auth token refresh and centralized retry policy across Python/TS/Go.
- Streaming: aligned event model and improved client lifecycle (explicit Close/Stop).
- Bumped package versions: python 2.5.0, typescript 1.10.0, go v0.19.0.
- Non-breaking for typical usage; see migration notes for streaming Close/Stop behavior.
